mapper.sql: select r.id, r.tenant_id as tenantId, r.company_id as companyId, c.company_name as companyName, r.station_id as stationId, s.station_name as stationName, r.rule_name as ruleName, r.metric_key as metricKey, r.device_type as deviceType, r.condition_op as conditionOp, r.threshold_value as thresholdValue, r.duration_seconds as durationSeconds, r.severity, r.enabled, r.notify_enabled as notifyEnabled, r.notify_channels as notifyChannels, r.notify_targets as notifyTargets, r.create_time as createTime, r.update_time as updateTime, r.remark from ems_alarm_rule r left join ems_company c on c.id = r.company_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join ems_station s on s.id = r.station_id and s.del_flag = '0' where r.del_flag = '0'

when.test: (scope.companyIds != null and scope.companyIds.size() > 0) or (scope.stationIds != null and scope.stationIds.size() > 0)

mapper.select: order by case when r.enabled = '1' then 0 else 1 end asc, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time) desc, r.id desc

select * from ems_alarm_rule r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.enabled = '1' and r.notify_enabled = '1' and (r.company_id = 0 or r.company_id = #{companyId}) and (r.station_id = 0 or r.station_id = #{stationId})
and (r.device_type is null or r.device_type = '' or r.device_type = #{deviceType})
and r.metric_key = #{metricKey}
and (r.severity is null or r.severity = '' or r.severity = #{severity})
order by case when r.station_id > 0 then 0 else 1 end asc, case when r.company_id > 0 then 0 else 1 end asc, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time) desc, r.id desc
